03 / How we work

A clear path from
idea to launch.

Scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria are agreed together, so everyone knows what we are building and why.

  1. 0101 / Discover

    Understand the challenge.

    Explore your business, users, and goals.

  2. 0202 / Define

    Make the plan clear.

    Agree on requirements, scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria.

  3. 0303 / Design

    Shape the experience.

    Review the design and proposed solution before development.

  4. 0404 / Develop

    Bring it to life.

    Build the agreed solution with regular progress reviews.

  5. 0505 / Validate

    Check what matters.

    Verify functionality, usability, and the agreed acceptance criteria.

  6. 0606 / Launch & support

    Prepare for what’s next.

    Plan the release and agree on ongoing support responsibilities.
